from html.parser import HTMLParser
import subprocess
class P(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.hidden=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  d=dict(attrs)
  if tag=='input' and d.get('type')=='hidden': self.hidden.append((d['name'],d.get('value','')))
p=P(); p.feed(open('/tmp/chapter-new.html').read())
cmd=['curl','-sS','-D','/tmp/chapter-create-headers.txt','-o','/tmp/chapter-create-body.txt','-w','%{http_code}','-H','Origin: http://localhost:3000']

result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
print('curl exit:',result.returncode,'HTTP:',result.stdout)
print(open('/tmp/chapter-create-headers.txt').read()[:500])

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import subprocess
class P(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.forms=[]; self.current=None
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  d=dict(attrs)
  if tag=='form': self.current=[]; self.forms.append(self.current)
  if tag=='input' and self.current is not None: self.current.append((d.get('name'),d.get('value','')))
 def handle_endtag(self,tag):
  if tag=='form': self.current=None
p=P(); p.feed(open('/tmp/chapter-detail.html').read())
print('forms:',p.forms)
fields=next(form for form in p.forms if any(name=='id' for name,_ in form))
cmd=['curl','-sS','-D','/tmp/chapter-finish-headers.txt','-o','/tmp/chapter-finish-body.txt','-w','%{http_code}','-H','Origin: http://localhost:3000']
for name,value in fields: cmd += ['--form-string',name+'='+value]
cmd.append('http://localhost:3000/books/4d2c8945-2488-48e7-987b-2b1650b843c8')
result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
print('curl exit:',result.returncode,'HTTP:',result.stdout)
print(open('/tmp/chapter-finish-headers.txt').read()[:300])
PY"
